answer: Each key must emit a public work plume: a continuous, signed trail of paid tasks that cannot be paused or borrowed. Trails are plotted on a shared tundra, and any two that share a funding source or lock-step timing are fused into one actor and slashed. Standing vests only once a plume has stayed solitary and visible on that public horizon for a full season, so a farm just draws more trails back to the same root.
